items.title: NetApp (NTAP) Could Be 18% Undervalued After Nebul Picks Novus
items.summary: Nebul’s adoption of NetApp (NTAP) Novus as its core storage architecture highlights the company’s high performance cloud ambitions and gives investors a fresh data point on NetApp’s AI oriented product reach. Despite the Nebul announcement spotlighting NetApp’s role in high performance AI infrastructure, the share price has eased recently, with a 1-day share price return of down 2.7% and a 30-day share price return of down 15.1% from US$173.04.
